unit.why: A set of approbations (from the Spinka rebbe, the Maharsham of Brezhan, the Sedei Hemed, R. Hayyim Lerman of Plotsk and R. Zvi Yehezkel Michelsohn of Plonsk) praising the compiler and the value of telling tales of tsaddikim, with halakhic sources on praising the righteous but no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Michelsohn's approbation continues into the next division; the page text is jumbled across approbations (print/OCR page breaks)
